datedSection.heading: Updates to generative plugins and shaders
datedSection.quote: Sep 1, 2026 Updates to generative plugins and shaders New release Update Figma AI Figma Community Collaboration Design Copy link Sep 1, 2026 Updates to generative plugins and shaders New release Update Figma AI Figma Community Collaboration Design Copy link At Config, we launched the ability build your own custom generative plugins and shaders by prompting the Figma agent. Now, you can do more with those generative plugins and shaders with animations and interactions, publishing capabilities, and access to the code. Animated and interactive shaders : Prompt the agent to build a custom shader effect or fill that incorporates motion and is reactive to mouse movements. Learn more. Community publishing : Share your generative plugins and shaders with the world by publishing them for others to use on the Figma Community. Learn more about Community publishing for shaders and Community publishing for generative plugins. Publish to organization : Share private generative plugins and shaders with your organization to standardize effects or tool usage. Only available on Organization and Enterprise plans. Learn more. Code viewer : View and download the code for any shader and your own generative plugins, right in Figma. Learn more. MCP updates : View and make changes to your generative plugins and shaders with a third party agent via Figma’s MCP server. Plus, when you copy a Figma frame with shaders applied to an external agent, on implementation the shaders will render correctly in the generated React code. Learn more . Read the blog post

datedSection.heading: Open the agent chat panel in a new window
datedSection.quote: Aug 26, 2026 Open the agent chat panel in a new window New release Figma AI Desktop app Assets Design Copy link Aug 26, 2026 Open the agent chat panel in a new window New release Figma AI Desktop app Assets Design Copy link You can now open the agent chat panel into a new window on the Figma desktop app for both macOS and Windows. It stays visible when you work with other tools or switch tabs. Here's what's new: → Open the agent chat panel into its own window → Move it anywhere on your screen → Always keep it visible while you design Download the desktop app here.
